question: In the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin intervene (n):
analysis: Peptides of extracellular origin are typically processed and presented by Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC) class II molecules. The HLA-DM molecule plays a crucial role in the loading of these peptides onto MHC class II molecules. Therefore, the correct option that intervenes in the processing and presentation of peptides of extracellular origin is HLA-DM.
